intro: Below the citadel stands the Afyonkarahisar Great Mosque, a mosque and complex in Afyonkarahisar province, dated 1272. Its flat roof rests on forty wooden columns, making it one of the earliest dated Seljuk timber mosques.
history: Built in 1272 below the citadel, the mosque carries its flat roof on forty wooden columns, which makes it one of the earliest dated timber hypostyle mosques. Look up at the capitals: their painted decoration is largely original. In 2023 the mosque joined the World Heritage List.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the forty wooden columns and the painted capitals, then the brick minaret and the wooden ceiling.
facts: Did you know? Its brick minaret, banded with turquoise tile, is the westernmost example of the Seljuk minaret tradition. And dated 1272, the mosque is among the earliest dated timber hypostyle mosques.
outro: This brings our visit to the Afyonkarahisar Great Mosque to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Let these forty columns stand for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
